correctness.rationale: Q_d is bipartite; open-neighborhood complex separates into the even and odd word components, exchanged by odd translation. Each odd y induces a d-point simplex F_y={y+e_i}; different centers have at most two common neighbors, so every face of dimension≥2 has exactly one facet. In each F_y choose apex y+e_1 and descending-cardinality elementary collapse pairs σ⊂σ∪{apex}, |σ|≥3, preserving the entire shared 1-skeleton and every apex triangle. This gives 2D L_d. Edges of the halved cube have differences e_i+e_j; triangles factor each non-generator edge into e_1+e_j cube-generator edges and pairs of triangles fill every coordinate square. The (d−1)-cube 2-skeleton is simply connected, so L_d has π1=0. Exact faces f0=2^(d−1), f1=2^(d−2)binom(d,2), f2=2^(d−1)binom(d−1,2), giving free H2 of rank μ=2^(d−3)(d²−5d+8)−1 by Euler; Whitehead gives a μ-fold wedge S² for each component. Independent integer count d=4,5,6,7 produces μ=7,31,111,351; this is corroboration, not a finite proof of every d≥4.
